courseLedger.name: Epidemiology & Public Health

availableEvidence.description2:

You will learn how to study disease, risks, and changes over time, and how to critically evaluate evidence. Because behind every public health decision lies a question of evidence, and by the end of this course, you will be equipped to engage with it.
